The '''Urban Assault Triped Transport''', or '''UA-TT''', was a [[First Order]] [[walker]] used for pacification operations.

The UA-TT could deploy its [[CAP-5 captivator arm]] for stabilized firing. Such designs dated back to the [[Clone Wars]]-era [[All Terrain Attack Pod|AT-AP]] walkers used by the [[Galactic Republic]]. The limb could also be used to grab enemies hiding in buildings using its claws. In order to use heavy machinery in an urban area, the First Order deployed UA-TT walkers as opposed to the larger, heavier [[All Terrain MegaCaliber Six|AT-M6]] walkers. This was done so the city in question would not be destroyed during occupation.<ref name="TROS VD" />

An UA-TT was deployed to [[Naboo]], the homeworld of [[Darth Sidious|Emperor Sheev Palpatine]], in [[34 ABY]] during the [[Assault on Naboo (First Order)|Assault of Naboo]].<ref name="Legacy of Vader 5">{{WebCite|url=https://aiptcomics.com/2025/06/20/marvel-preview-star-wars-legacy-of-vader-5/|text=Marvel Preview: Star Wars: Legacy of Vader #5|archivedate=20250620192913}}</ref>

In [[35 ABY]], during the [[First Order-Resistance War]], at least one was deployed on [[Kijimi]].<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref>

{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The UA-TT first appeared in the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']].<ref name="TROS" /> The vehicle was first identified as Urban Assault Triped Transport in the 2019 [[Dorling Kindersley]] reference books ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]''<ref name="TROS VD" /> and ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Galactic Guide]]''.<ref name="TROS GG">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Galactic Guide]]''</ref>

In ''Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary'', the vehicle was stated to have the height of 6.52 meters.<ref name="TROS VD" /> However, the [[2025]] Dorling Kindersley reference book [[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles (second edition)|''Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles'' second edition]] changed the height of the UA-TT to 10.3 meters,<ref name="EOSAOV2" /> a value that was initially attributed to the vehicle's length instead.<ref name="TROS VD" /> This article assumes the height value to be an error.
